acceptance_criteria: buyer can understand SolidStart, see the value promise, reach a demo or checkout path, and receive the promised workflow outcome after payment
alternatives: manual process, spreadsheets, generic SaaS tools, internal scripts, agencies, or delaying the workflow
buyer: buyer hypothesis for app; Market Intelligence must validate reachable buyer and budget
demand_signal: desk-researched from local product README, deployment status, active $1M MRR goal, and product pricing notes; must be confirmed by outreach before scale
icp: buyer hypothesis for app; Market Intelligence must validate reachable buyer and budget
mvp_scope: product landing/API or workflow entrypoint, health check, checkout path, onboarding path, fulfillment notes, and smoke-test evidence for SolidStart
non_goals: do not scale paid outreach, claim MRR, or modify verified Polar setup before checkout/provider evidence exists
package: Starter: Polar subscription target around $29/mo; include a bounded service promise for SolidStart; replace with verified product-specific Polar price before send
pain: workflow pain hypothesis around app; Market Intelligence must validate urgency and alternatives
polar_provider: Polar.sh canonical; do not modify verified setup without explicit approval
pricing: Free tier plus $29/mo Polar subscription target; existing x402/USDC usage paywall is product capability, not canonical MRR provider.
promise: turn workflow pain hypothesis around app; Market Intelligence must validate urgency and alternatives into a repeatable outcome using SolidStart: Everything you need to build a Solid project, powered by [`solid-start`](https://start.solidjs.com);
risk: local evidence is desk-researched; demand, production readiness, checkout, and fulfillment still require strict downstream proof
sales_angle: reduce manual effort, delay, or risk in the buyer workflow with SolidStart
trigger: buyer has a repeated operational workflow where SolidStart can remove manual work, risk, or delay
validation_status: desk-researched hypothesis ready for Growth/Sales outreach validation
wedge: product-specific workflow around SolidStart with a clear Polar checkout path, support promise, and bounded fulfillment SOP
